question: The ratio of government debt to consumer spending by year
query: To get the ratio of `government_debt` to `consumer_spending` for each year, you can use the following SQL query: ```sql SELECT date, finance_economics_dataset.date as year, (finance_economics_dataset.government_debt / finance_economics_dataset.consumer_spending) as debt_to_consuming_ratio FROM finance_economics_dataset WHERE finance_economics_dataset.date >= (SELECT date FROM finance_economics_dataset ORDER BY date LIMIT 1) AND finance_economics_dataset.date < (SELECT date FROM finance_economics_dataset ORDER BY date OFFSET 50) ORDER BY finance_economics_dataset.date; ``` This query will give you the ratio of government debt to consumer spending for the last 50 years from your `finance_economics_dataset`. The WHERE clause is used to limit the results to 50 rows.
